mapper.select: SELECT cm.comment_id , cm.collection_id , cm.user_id , cm.content , cm.created_at , cm.updated_at , u.nickname , u.profile_image , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes l WHERE l.comment_id = cm.comment_id) AS like_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes l WHERE l.comment_id = cm.comment_id AND l.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked_by_me FROM comments cm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.collection_id = #{collectionId} ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC
